head: edf66431cb96696589fa3a0f8d3299b1a7601637
claim: An app that installs the released @byokit/openclaw 0.27.4 no longer signs a person out when the Claude Code sign-in check is slow: it reads unknown after a retry past 10 s and the run ends as a retryable network error, a recovering check reads signed in, and a signed-out check still reads signed out.

steps.start: The app has a member whose Claude Code login is checked by the engine's probe, with a 3 s limit.
steps: The app asks signInState while the probe takes 3.5 s and errors every time
The app asks signInState while the probe errors twice and then answers signed in
The app asks signInState while the probe answers signed out
Each time the app starts a Claude Code run for the member
steps.result: The always-slow probe reads unknown after a retry past 10 s and the run ends network; the recovering probe reads signed-in and the run is ok; the signed-out probe reads signed-out and the run ends signed-out.

verdicts.seen: I read all 3 entries. Slow probe: state unknown, run network, seconds 12.6 (past 10 s), so it ends as a retryable network error as the outcome says. Slow twice then signed in: state signed-in, run ok, providerStatus claude-cli, so a recovering check reads signed in. Signed out: state signed-out, run signed-out, so a signed-out check still reads signed out. The before run on 0.27.3 shows the old behavior of ending as signed-out, which contrasts with the fix. The outcome names no separate widths or frames, so parts and covers stay empty.
